title: Render the whole site after a backend deploy
description: When the backend deploy finishes (new renderer or theme in the content-actions Lambda), run a full render (today: project --all) inside AWS, then the drift check (--reconcile --dry-run, and --reconcile for orphans). Options: a post-deploy step in the build spec, or the content Lambda rendering everything when its bundled site code hash changes. Done: a theme-only PR goes live on anth.us with no manual step, the drift check is clean, and the run's result is visible in the build log.
right_now_summary: The team is choosing how to trigger a full site render after each backend deploy.
